prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='FT_rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_DWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: FT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ONLY_DWT_rf leads in seasonality (0.4789) and overall RMSE (126.38). The high rmse_spread_ratio (23.36) and concept drift detection indicate significant model disagreement and non-stationarity. STL-hierarchical stacking is recommended to exploit the complementary strengths of trend and seasonality champions while handling the detected drift through component-wise combination.
